messages.content: I want to ensure that I'm providing accurate information to my users depending on what they're looking for. If someone asks to 'show me my balance', which intent should I classify this query as from the options 'get_balance', 'transfer_funds', 'hello', or 'goodbye'?

function.name: get_response
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves the response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds to wait for the server's response. Defaults to 5.0 seconds if not provided. This is a float type value.

Accept.description: The MIME type expected in the response, such as 'application/json' or 'text/html'.

User-Agent.description: The User-Agent string to be sent with the request, identifying the client software.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to be sent with the GET request. If not provided, default headers will be used.

intent.description: The intent of the user from a predefined list of intents, such as 'purchase', 'information', or 'support'.
